Why do people think that rewarding 0 effort in this market is healthy? 

I get $DOGE, maybe even $PEPE or $WIF. 

I just don’t get that you’ll think throwing hundreds of millions to jokes created in 5 min is something net positive for this industry. It is NOT.

I missed $DOGE, $SHIBA, $PEPE, $BONK, $WIF, $SPX 

In hindsight these all look like obvious plays. At least people had time to buy them at cheap or reasonable prices before their crazy pumps. I was there, and knowing it sounded too good, didn’t buy it.

I’m not fading @theunipcs
